PALANTIR $PLTR JUST SAID IT GOT A MAJOR WIN FROM THE U.S. ARMY

The Army has officially established the foundational data architecture for NGC2, its highest-priority modernization program.

Palantir's Foundry is the cloud data layer. Anduril's Lattice is the tactical data layer.

NGC2 is the Army's Next Generation Command and Control program, and Palantir has been embedded in it since the earliest prototyping phases.

What this means in plain English: the Army just locked in the underlying architecture for how it will process and act on battlefield data at scale. Palantir is the foundation that everything else gets built on top of.

Palantir President and CTO Akash Jain:

"By establishing a common data baseline for NGC2 from the outset, the Army is creating the foundation on which future applications and AI-enabled mission capabilities can be built. Foundry helps make that foundation durable and extensible, ready to deliver decision advantage to Soldiers as NGC2 moves from prototype to production."

Also in the ecosystem: Lockheed Martin $LMT alongside Anduril and a broad range of defense partners.
